instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
1 small bunch fresh dill
3 medium zucchini squash
3 tomatoes

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice lemons into a small bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the bowl with oil and whisk to combine the marinade. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 cloves garlic
⅓ cup extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Trim zucchini, halve lengthwise, and slice into thin half moons. Halve tomatoes and slice into half moons. Set aside on a plate.
Peel and slice onions into half rings.
Pat chicken dry with paper towels and season with salt and pepper. Make 5 crosswise slits in each breast, being careful not to cut through completely.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place chicken on a large sheet pan and stuff each slit with a slice of zucchini, tomato, and onion. Add remaining veggies to the sheet pan next to the chicken.
Drizzle chicken and vegetables with the marinade.
Grate mozzarella. Sprinkle cheeses over the chicken and vegetables.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ (227 g) block mozzarella cheese
1 ½ (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Place in the oven and bake for 25-30 minutes, until chicken is cooked through.
To serve, divide chicken and vegetables between plates. Enjoy!
